_source: src/12-campaign.js CAMPAIGN (id, title, sub, fac, enemy, map, brief, obj, win, lose) + CAMP_DIFF / CAMP_MUL  (JS game, branch js-final; read from the running page by tools-godot/export_data.mjs)
_notes: Texts and objective lists are data. The scripted triggers are JavaScript (setup(c) places the forces, tick(c,dt) runs waves / timers / objective checks through the CH helper table): their source is in script_js for the hand-port, and radio_lines are the argument lists of every CH.say(text, kind) call in them, as written in the script (JS string expressions: a quoted text, + a value, + more text).

missions.title: Hold the Pass
missions.subtitle: Hezbollah · Ridge defense in the southern hills
briefing: An invasion force is pushing up the only road into our valleys, below the limestone ridge. Our main columns are still six minutes away on the mountain tracks.
You hold the ridge above the road with a small garrison: riflemen, anti-tank teams, two tanks and three dug-in guns. A depot behind the ridge keeps the guns supplied - keep it ours.
Hold the ridge until the reinforcements arrive. Then do not let the enemy rest: take the fight back down the pass and destroy their forward base.

objectives.text: Hold the ridge until reinforcements arrive

missions.win_text: The pass is ours. The valley is safe, and the road is closed to the invaders.
missions.lose_text: The ridge has fallen. The valley will have to be defended from the next line.
radio_lines: 'Briefing: hold the ridge for '+campClock(c.T)+'. Dug-in guns cover the road; the depot behind you is yours while you stand near it.','g'

missions.title: Supply Run
missions.subtitle: Ansarallah · Convoy escort across the highlands
briefing: A highland town is surrounded. Its people have food for days, not weeks, and the road in is held by irregulars and raiders of the besieging force.
Six supply trucks are loaded at your depot. Escort them up through the wadis to the town. Expect ambushes from the ridges and the dry riverbeds - they will hit the trucks first.
At least four trucks must reach the town. An old cistern depot sits at the halfway ridge: take it for water and money. Scout ahead, keep the escort close, and do not drive blind into the narrows.

objectives.text: Cross the highlands to the halfway ridge
Take the cistern depot at the ridge (optional)
Break the siege line around the town
Deliver at least 4 of 6 trucks to the town

missions.win_text: The convoy has reached the town. The siege is broken and the people eat tonight.
missions.lose_text: The convoy is lost. The town is on its own.
radio_lines: 'Briefing: six trucks, four must arrive. Ambushes wait on both sides of the road.','g'

missions.title: Mountain Fortress
missions.subtitle: Iran · Build and defend in the Zagros
briefing: Our command post sits in a mountain valley that the enemy must take to open the road to the plains. They will come in waves - infantry first, then armor, then everything they have. The Ayatollah is with the garrison; stay close to him and his sermon will steady your lines.
Build a Mountain Fortress: its rock-cut bunker is nearly immune to shells, and a garrison inside is safe from artillery. A field depot beside the command post pays you while you hold it.
Hold headquarters until the relief columns arrive. Late in the battle the enemy will send bunker-buster aircraft against the Fortress - you get a warning; take the garrison out in time.
missions.win_text: Relief columns have arrived. The valley held.
missions.lose_text: Headquarters has fallen. The valley is lost.
radio_lines: 'Briefing: build the Mountain Fortress, hold '+campClock(c.T)+'. E and Shift+E use the Ayatollah.','g'

missions.title: Retake the Village
missions.subtitle: Hezbollah + Ansarallah · Fortified village
briefing: An occupation force has dug into a hill village at the crossroads. Its stone houses are held by infantry and anti-tank teams, with armor in the lanes and their own fuel depot at the far gate.
Hezbollah and Ansarallah fight side by side: our riflemen and mortars with their mobile technicals. The ally is controlled by its own commander - give it room and follow its lead on the flanks.

Clear the approach and the two flank lanes, take the village square, then recapture the fuel depot at the far gate. Put infantry into houses to hold ground you have taken - garrisoned riflemen are hard to dislodge. The enemy will counter-attack with reserves from the north.

objectives.text: Recapture the fuel depot at the far gate
Garrison a house to hold ground
Beat back the counter-attacks and hold the village

missions.win_text: The village is free and the depot is ours again. Both flags fly over the square.
missions.lose_text: The assault has failed. Our columns fall back.
radio_lines: 'Briefing: five fronts - three approaches, the square, the depot. Houses can be garrisoned.','g'

missions.title: Combined Arms
missions.subtitle: Iran · Final assault on the Caspian coast
briefing: This is the strike that ends the offensive. The enemy has dug a fortified base on the coast: air-defence sites on the approaches, armor in depth, a War Factory and a command post at the back.

You command a combined force: loitering drones, missile artillery, tanks, infantry and anti-air. The drones cannot fly while the enemy air-defence sites stand - take those out first with artillery and the ground force, then bring the drones in.
Break the air defenses, destroy the vehicle factory so the armor cannot be replaced, then destroy the headquarters. You have a field depot and a small base behind you for reinforcements.
missions.win_text: The enemy command post is rubble. The offensive is over.
radio_lines: 'Briefing: air defenses first, then the factory, then the headquarters.','g'

missions.title: Bridgehead on the Euphrates
missions.subtitle: Kataib Hezbollah · River crossing in the southern marshes
briefing: The road to the shrine cities runs over the Euphrates. The far bank is held by a task group dug in among the reeds: emplacements at the bridge end, anti-tank teams in the marsh grass, and an ammunition dump behind them that feeds their guns.

Our volunteer brigades gather on the west bank with riflemen, anti-tank teams, tanks and mortars. Mortars and guns can cover the bridge from your side - use them before the infantry cross. Armor on a bridge is a target; send riflemen first.

Seize the far end of the bridge, capture the ammunition dump so our guns have supplies on the east bank, and then hold the bridgehead while the engineers bring the main column over. Expect hard counter-attacks along the causeway.

objectives.text: Seize the east end of the bridge
Capture the ammunition dump on the east bank
Hold the bridgehead until the column crosses

missions.win_text: The bridgehead held and the column is over the river. The road to the shrine cities is open.
missions.lose_text: The bridgehead is lost. The brigades fall back to the west bank.
radio_lines: 'Briefing: mortars first, riflemen across, then the dump. Hold '+campClock(c.HOLD)+' once the east end is ours.','g'
